verdict.rationale: Graphite auto-runs AI reviews on every PR with no configuration needed (graphite-docs-4, graphite-docs-18, graphite-docs-19) and Graphite Chat can generate a PR summary/walkthrough on request ('Summarize the changes in this PR', 'explain what changed... highlight potential issues' — graphite-docs-6, graphite-docs-21, graphite-docs-15). However the summary/walkthrough capability appears to be a chat-driven, on-demand feature rather than an automatically-posted summary comment on every PR, and no evidence shows a structured 'walkthrough' artifact attached automatically like some competitors. Missing for 10: evidence of an automatically-posted summary/walkthrough comment on every PR (not just on-demand chat), and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific behavior.
